prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: genuine animation sprite sheet for existing native-pixel side-view game MAX. Input image: identity and pixel-style reference showing eight older poses of ONE boss. Expand that SAME creature into 32 genuinely different, hand-authored key poses. Preserve the exact creature identity, colors, silhouette vocabulary, dark teal outline, tiny chunky pixel clusters and asymmetric details.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and EIGHT EQUAL ROWS, 32 complete isolated sprites, one in every cell, transparent RGBA, tall 1:2 canvas. Logical cell size 32x32, overall 128x256 logical pixels, may render enlarged with crisp nearest square pixel blocks. All sprites fit within 28x29 logical pixels, remain same scale and face right, ground-contact pixel aligned to same local bottom baseline in every cell. Keep fixed pelvis/body registration; change local limbs/jaws/appendages and their deformation. No whole-body clone translations, no duplicate pose cells, no zoom. Every row is a continuous four-frame action with clearly different readable silhouette at each frame.
ROWS in exact top-to-bottom order: idle (4), move (4), windup (4), attack (4), recover (4), vulnerable (4), hurt (4), death (4). Four frames read left-to-right. Death ends with a small settled heap, not blank. No text or labels or borders or checkerboard or scenery or ground/shadow. Real alpha background.
STYLE: true low-resolution 32px game sprites, approximately 10-15 solid colors. Absolutely no antialiasing, blur, gradient, smooth painting or glossy 3D. Existing muted dark teal #10171c #1d2b34 #2b4645; moss #3d5146 #536448; bark #605047 #82725b; cream #b5b190 #d7d4b1; restrained purple #493650 #847088 and rust #663d35 #95523c. Amber #ab7833 #d4a64e ONLY row 3 windup; cyan #4b8e92 #77bbb9 ONLY row 6 vulnerable. Other rows no bright magic colors.
Subject: SEED ENGINE, the reference's mossy teal seed mill creature, circular pale-edged wheel/cage around a dark central opening, three purple seed pods riding around the wheel rim, low heavy rooted mechanical base. Preserve its compact wheel-shaped silhouette. Row 1: four visible quarter-turn positions of the seed rotor and different piston extension; body stationary. Row 2: four articulated stepping or crawling root-tread poses with rotor counterrotation. Row 3: pistons lower base, rotor draws pods inward, seed chamber opens, small amber core loaded with tense pistons. Row 4: wheel recoils, chamber bursts with short seed volley contained within cell, wheel overspins, base stomps. Row 5: four decreasing rebounds, rotor slows and pistons extend. Row 6: casing open exposing small cyan core; seed pod arms orbit to four distinct angles, core pulse. Row 7: cage buckles sideways, rim deforms, pod folds, support roots catch stumble. Row 8: rim cracks, pods and spoke break apart, central mill collapses, low pile of rim and seed husks. Make mechanical parts actually move; not duplicate still wheel or whole-body shifts.
